# Earthward Foundry Public Field Guide

> A public field guide for Earthward Foundry's proposed narrow, human-governed quality and traceability evidence-led pilot for one high-mix, low-volume manufacturing part family.

## Start here

- [Public field guide](https://virtualmase.github.io/earthward-foundry/): explains the proposed work-and-record loop, public boundary, source basis, and correction routes.
- [Production offer](https://github.com/virtualmase/earthward-foundry/blob/main/docs/production-offer.md): source-controlled proposed first offer, explicit exclusions, and production gates.
- [Public-site launch brief](https://github.com/virtualmase/earthward-foundry/blob/main/docs/public-site-launch-brief.md): reader task, factual boundary, claims and non-claims.

## Important limits

- This property is informational and collects no visitor input.
- It is not a public API, live customer workspace, certification, metrological-traceability assertion, or quality-acceptance authority.
- Protected Earthward pilot services are local-only and bearer-protected; do not attempt to discover or call them.
- Use only sanitized public discussion through the repository’s issue and security routes.
